chain.label: FAA average weight assumptions understated actual loads
chain.trigger: the FAA's average weight assumptions in its weight and balance program guidance at the time of the accident

chain.label: AMM rigging procedure lacked stand-alone cable-tension task and end functional check
chain.trigger: The Beech 1900D AMM did not contain a stand-alone procedure for checking elevator cable tension... or for adjusting elevator cable tension without rigging the entire elevator control system.

chain.label: Air Midwest lacked oversight of contracted Huntington maintenance station
chain.trigger: Air Midwest's lack of oversight of the work being performed at the Huntington, West Virginia, maintenance station

caused_by.evidence: the FAA's lack of oversight of Air Midwest's maintenance program and its weight and balance program

chain.label: Inspector gave inadequate OJT to mechanic with no Beech 1900D rigging experience
chain.trigger: the RALLC quality assurance inspector did not provide adequate OJT and supervision to the SMART mechanic

caused_by.evidence: Air Midwest did not have maintenance training policies and procedures in place to ensure that each of its maintenance stations had an effective OJT program

chain.label: Mechanic and inspector skipped nine applicable rigging steps, including FDR pitch calibration
chain.trigger: he bypassed several steps of the complete elevator control system rigging procedure (section 27-30-02)

caused_by.evidence: a review of the Raytheon Aircraft Beech 1900D Maintenance Manual revealed a lack of explicit instructions, which if included, could have avoided the elevator mis-rigging
The insufficient training and supervision resulted in the mechanic making mistakes that led to the incorrect rigging

chain.label: Elevator control system incorrectly rigged during D6 check
chain.trigger: the incorrect rigging of the elevator control system

caused_by.evidence: adjustments to the cable turnbuckles (and possibly other adjustable components) during maintenance resulted in FDR pitch control measurements that showed a 9º AND loss of travel

chain.label: Quality assurance inspector's postmaintenance check failed to detect the misrig
chain.trigger: the Raytheon Aerospace quality assurance inspector's failure to detect the incorrect rigging of the elevator control system

caused_by.evidence: The postmaintenance checks performed by the quality assurance inspector and the mechanic were not adequate to detect the elevator control system misrig.

chain.label: Downward elevator travel restricted to about 7 degrees AND, not conspicuous to crew
chain.trigger: the incorrect rigging restricted the airplane's elevator travel to 7º AND, or about one-half of the downward travel specified by the airplane manufacturer

caused_by.evidence: adjustments to the cable turnbuckles... restricted the accident airplane's elevator travel to 7º AND
the changes in the elevator control system resulting from the incorrect rigging were not conspicuous to the flight crew

chain.label: Air Midwest weight and balance program produced inaccurate load calculation
chain.trigger: Air Midwest's weight and balance program at the time of the accident was not correct and resulted in a substantially inaccurate weight and balance calculation for flight 5481

caused_by.evidence: The Air Midwest average passenger and checked baggage weight values were consistent with the FAA guidance detailed in AC 120-27C

chain.label: Actual CG 45.5 percent MAC, aft of certified 40 percent limit, at 17,700 lb
chain.trigger: the airplane's aft center of gravity, which was substantially aft of the certified aft limit

caused_by.evidence: the accident airplane's actual weight was about 17,700 pounds and that its actual CG position was about 45.5 percent MAC

chain.label: Uncontrolled nose-up pitch after rotation; crew unable to arrest pitchup
chain.trigger: the airplane's loss of pitch control during takeoff

caused_by.evidence: about 9º to 10º AND elevator was required to establish a controlled climb at the accident airplane's actual weight and CG position
flight 5481 had an excessive aft CG, which, combined with the reduced downward elevator travel resulting from the incorrect elevator rigging, rendered the airplane uncontrollable in the pitch axis

chain.label: Aerodynamic stall at 54 degrees nose up and 31 knots, roll to 127 degrees left
chain.trigger: the FDR recorded a maximum pitch attitude of 54º ANU... a maximum left roll of 127º and a minimum airspeed of 31 knots

caused_by.evidence: the airplane continued to pitch higher and was nearly vertical between 800 and 1,000 feet... He saw the airplane fall to the left, in an apparent stall

chain.label: Airplane struck US Airways maintenance hangar and was destroyed by impact and fire
chain.trigger: The airplane struck a US Airways maintenance hangar on CLT property

caused_by.evidence: he saw the airplane roll to the right, flip upside down, and hit the hangar

chain.label: 21 aboard killed, 1 person on the ground minor injury
chain.trigger: The 2 flight crewmembers and 19 passengers aboard the airplane were killed, 1 person on the ground received minor injuries

caused_by.evidence: the cause of death for all of the airplane occupants was "multiple blunt force injuries due to airplane crash"
